name: UDM-Beast
title: Dream Machine Beast
summary: Flagship 1U Cloud Gateway: 25 Gbps IPS, 25G SFP28 WAN/LAN, 8x 10GbE, 2 NVR bays, full app suite.

extra.power_supply: single internal 150W AC + USP-RPS DC input
extra.tag_redundant_power_means: RPS DC input, not dual AC PSUs

gotchas: No PoE output on any port - every AP/camera needs a separate PoE switch (e.g. USW-Pro-HD-24-PoE / ECS-24-PoE).
Single internal AC PSU; 'redundant power' = DC backup via a separately bought USP-RPS ($399), not hot-swap dual PSUs.
Only 2x 3.5" bays: rated for 40x 4K cameras but long retention at that scale needs a dedicated NVR.
Massive overkill for homes/small offices (IPS 25 Gbps, 7,500 clients) - a UCG-class gateway does a <1 Gbps WAN fine.
25G SFP28/10G SFP+ ports need modules or DACs, not included.
not_for: sites wanting PoE from the gateway
large camera fleets with long retention
